# Public handoff update — v0.1.3-r10.37

The current handoff now includes a non-author protected lockbox work package:

- Release: https://github.com/ahvsjags/BioInterfaceOS/releases/tag/v0.1.3-r10.37
- Scientific candidate: `v0.1.3-r10.32`
- Lockbox package: `docs/external/LOCKBOX_EVALUATOR_WORK_PACKAGE_R10_36.md`
- Adoption catalog: `docs/external/EXTERNAL_USER_TASK_CATALOG_R10_35.md`
- Coordination issue: https://github.com/ahvsjags/BioInterfaceOS/issues/2

The package specifies pre-access freezing, evaluator custody of row-level input,
aggregate-only return, required uncertainty/ablation/negative/OOD outputs and
identity/COI/hash/signature requirements. It is a participant interface, not
a lockbox receipt; the independent-validation count remains zero.
